svg.title: WebSocket frame format
svg.desc: RFC 6455 frame layout, 32 bits per row. Row 1: FIN (1 bit), RSV1, RSV2, RSV3 (1 bit each), opcode (4 bits), MASK (1 bit), payload len (7 bits), then a 16-bit extended payload length used if payload len is 126 or 127. Row 2: extended payload length continued, if payload len is 127. Row 3: the end of the extended payload length, then the masking key if MASK is 1. Row 4: the rest of the masking key, then the payload data. Row 5: payload data continued. Optional fields have dashed borders.

g.text: Extended payload length continued, if payload len == 127
